title: SemanticContextResult
description: The machine-readable form of one `Semantic code context` section produced for one coding job. Either the section was injected with bounded, deduplicated, in-scope hits, or it fell back to exact search with an explicit trigger. There is no third state and no partial state.

consumer.description: Which coding job requested the section, e.g. `implement-feature`. Distinct per consumer so ri-13 can evaluate injection value per job type.

requested_revision.description: Full Git object ID of HEAD in the agent's own worktree. Present on fallback too — it is what the fallback was requested for.

hits.description: Retained hits in final rendered order (the deterministic rank order of design decision D5).

omissions.description: Every hit the service returned but the section did not render, with the single reason that excluded it. Present on fallback as an empty array.

reason.description: The first failing check in the fixed evaluation order, so the reason is a function of the inputs alone.

provenance.description: Which index answered and under what authority. Present only when status is `injected`.

scope_authority.description: Mirrors ri-03's `ScopeDisposition.authority`. `principal_grant` today, because ri-12 sends an explicit scope.

fallback.description: Why no semantic context was injected and what to do instead. Present only when status is `fallback`.

trigger.description: The four triggers of design decision D8.

reason.description: The specific cause. Distinct per cause so the four fallback tests can assert exactly, rather than only on the trigger.

strategy.description: Matches ri-03's `Fallback.strategy`. Exact search plus direct source reading is the only fallback.

service_state.description: The coordinator's `CodeSearchState`, when a query was actually issued. Absent when a local precondition short-circuited before the call.
